data.description:
# Comment sync (append-only) with persistent Jira-comment-ID map

## Context / Problem
Comment sync currently identifies comments by body equality, which is broken: two comments with the same text collide, and an edited body looks like a brand-new comment. To sync rich comments safely we need stable identity. The team has decided comment semantics are **append-only** — mirror comment creation both ways, but do not sync edits or deletes — which keeps the design simple and matches the reconciler's existing inbound behavior of skipping already-known Jira comment IDs.

## Approach
Maintain a **persistent map from rebar comment event → Jira comment ID** in the binding state, so identity is by ID, not body text. Outbound: when rebar has a new comment with no mapped Jira ID, create it in Jira (rendered through the client's codec — ADF for Cloud, the one-way segmenting renderer for DC) and record the returned Jira comment ID. Inbound: mirror Jira comments whose IDs are not already in the map as new rebar comments. **Append-only**: do not push rebar edits/deletes to Jira comments and do not apply Jira comment edits/deletes to rebar — an already-mapped ID is never re-synced (this is the echo guard for comments and reuses the same state-based suppression as descriptions). The ID map is change-gated and fixed-shape (one small entry per comment, added once) to respect epic `0303`'s churn discipline. Descriptions ship before comments (separate story), so this builds on the codec + echo-suppression stories.

## Scope
- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/binding_store.py` — persistent per-binding comment-ID map (change-gated, append-only).
- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/` — comment differ using ID identity instead of body equality; outbound create + inbound mirror.
- `tests/` — comment identity + append-only tests.

## Testing
- Duplicate bodies: two rebar comments with identical text create two distinct Jira comments and map to two distinct IDs (no collision).
- Idempotence: a second reconcile pass creates 0 duplicate comments (mapped IDs are skipped).
- Append-only: a rebar comment edit does not push to Jira and a Jira comment edit does not overwrite rebar; only genuinely new comments mirror.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Comment identity is a persistent Jira-comment-ID map, not body equality; verified by `test_comment_duplicate_bodies_distinct_ids` (two identical-text comments map to two IDs).
- [ ] Comment sync is append-only in both directions — new comments mirror once, edits/deletes are not synced; verified by `test_comment_append_only` (an edit/delete triggers no cross-side write).
- [ ] A repeat reconcile pass creates no duplicate comments; verified by `test_comment_sync_idempotent`.
- [ ] The comment-ID map is change-gated and adds no per-pass churn; verified by the git-delta cost harness on a no-new-comment pass.
data.title: Comment sync (append-only) with persistent Jira-comment-ID map
